description: Whether buying missing National Insurance years adds to the State Pension, what it costs, and how long it takes to pay back. Use for 'is it worth buying two missing NI years'.

class2.description: The cheaper Class 2 rate: self-employed in the UK with profits under the small profits threshold, or a year abroad before 2026/27 (Class 2 can't be paid for time abroad from 2026/27). Defaults to false.

qualifyingYears.description: Qualifying years on the NI record now.

yearsOfPension.description: Years of pension to total the gain over. Defaults to 20.

yearsStillToCome.description: Years still expected from work or credits before State Pension age. Defaults to 0.
